name: North Cascades National Park
policyReason: Pets are not allowed in the national park except leashed on the Pacific Crest Trail and two roads.
summary: Pets are not allowed in the national park except leashed on the Pacific Crest Trail and two roads.

excerpts.quote: Pets are not allowed within North Cascades National Park except when leashed on the Pacific Crest Trail.

dogRules.text: Leashed on Cascade River Road and Stehekin Valley Road to mile 12.9.
Ross Lake and Lake Chelan recreation areas allow leashed pets on all trails.
